grammar.point: 把 O V在 + place — put … at …
grammar.pattern: S + 把 + O + V + 在 + place
grammar.explain: To say a thing is MOVED/PUT somewhere, Mandarin uses 把: 把沙發放在客廳 (not 放沙發在客廳 ✗).

examples.zh: 我們把沙發放在客廳吧。
examples.id: Let's put the sofa in the living room.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 27, 29
note: After 把 + object the verb cannot stand alone; it needs 在/到 + place, 給 + person, 了, or a result complement: ✓ 把書放在桌子上。 ✗ 把書放。
The object of 把 is a specific, known thing: 這張桌子、我的書.
Negation and prohibition go BEFORE 把: 別把書放在椅子底下。 我沒把他的書拿來。

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 32
note: 把 + O + V + 了 + number of times: 她把生詞寫了三遍 (wrote the new words three times).
把 + O + V + 了 + part of O: 他把衣服脫了一件 (took off one of his layers).

latihan.why: 把 + O + 放在 + place.
After 把 + O, the verb cannot stand alone.

options: 把包包別放在椅子底下。
把別包包放在椅子底下。
別把包包放在椅子底下。
latihan.why: Prohibition/negation (別、沒、不) goes BEFORE 把.

latihan.q: 爸爸（　）沙發放在客廳裡了。
latihan.why: S + 把 + O + V + 在 + place: focus on what the doer did.

grammar.point: 把 O V到 + place + 來/去 — move … to …
grammar.pattern: S + 把 + O + V + 到 + place + (來/去)
grammar.explain: V到 + place = arrive at the destination; 來/去 shows the direction relative to the speaker: 把櫃子搬到臥室去 (carry it to the bedroom, away), 把它放到桌子上來 (put it on the table here).

examples.id: Carry the cupboard to the bedroom.

options: 把那張椅子拿到這裡來。
拿到這裡來把那張椅子。
把那張椅子到這裡拿來。

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 28–29
note: Direction of movement: V + 進/出/上/下/回/過 + 來/去: 把桌子搬進來、把書拿出來、把箱子搬上去. 來 = towards the speaker, 去 = away from the speaker.
把 is also used with result complements: 把門關上、把燈打開、把外套脫下來.

latihan.why: 把 + O + V到 + place + 去.

latihan.q: 把這張椅子拿到這裡（　）。 (towards the speaker)
latihan.why: 來 = towards the speaker; 去 = away.
Order: 把 + O + V + 到 + place + 來/去.
V + 出 + 來 = take out (towards the speaker).

core.note: The most common, standard word for "bedroom" — use this one. 主臥室 = master bedroom. In everyday talk people also often just say 房間.
Means the SAME as 臥室, but is less common and sounds more colloquial/traditional. Just recognise it when reading or listening; when speaking, use 臥室.

note: 把 is used when instructing where to put/move a specific item: 我們把沙發放在客廳吧。
它 = "it" for things, replacing an object already mentioned: 我們先把它放在樓下的房間吧。 (它 = 櫃子)
先 = first (before anything else); 吧 = a soft suggestion.
Rooms & buildings: 客廳 (living room), 臥室 / 臥房 (bedroom), 院子 (yard), 樓上 / 樓下 (upstairs/downstairs), 層 (floor): 房子有兩層。 座 = measure word for buildings: 這座房子.
Prohibition with 別: 你的書包別放在椅子底下 (topic first) = 別把你的書包放在椅子底下。

latihan.why: 把 + O + V + 在 + place.

latihan.q: 這個櫃子太重了，我們先把（　）放在樓下吧。 (it)
latihan.why: 它 = it (thing).
座 = measure word for buildings.
樓上 = upstairs; 樓下 = downstairs.

latihan.q: 你的書包（　）放在椅子底下。 (don't)
latihan.why: 別 = don't (prohibition).

modules.title: 我今天必須加班。
modules.title_py: Wǒ jīn tiān bì xū jiā bān.
modules.title_id: I have to work overtime today.
modules.scene: Dawen, an intern, has to work overtime to finish a report for a meeting; the next day his boss praises him and lets him off overtime.
can_do: Express strong obligation with 必須
Say 'no need' with 不用／不必
Talk about office work: 加班、開會、報告、要求
modules.exam_link: Office communication (meetings, reports, overtime) SOMETIMES appears in 聽力 Parts 3–4. 必須 vs 不必 is often the key to rule questions in 閱讀 Part 3.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我在一家公司上班。最近公司很忙，我每天都（1），晚上十點才回家。上個星期，老闆（2）大家星期五以前必須寫完報告。我的報告寫了三天才寫完。星期五早上（3）的時候，老闆說我的報告寫得很好，他說：「這個週末你（4）。」我很高興，因為我（5）好好休息一下。

tasks.instr: Read these office rules, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 大文：明天早上九點要開會，我不能去，請你替我開會。開會的報告我已經寫好了，放在你的桌子上。開會以前你不必再看一次，可是老闆要求大家十點以前必須交報告，請你開完會就交給他。謝謝！——小林

grammar.explain: 必須 = must, have to (stronger and more formal than 要). Its negative is NOT 不必須 but 不用 or 不必.

examples.id: I have to work overtime today.
I have to finish the report.

latihan.why: 必須 + V = must.
必須 goes after the subject, before the verb.
Lots of work → must work overtime: 必須.
要求 + person + V = require someone to …; 必須 is not followed by a person.

grammar.explain: 不用 (spoken) and 不必 (a little formal) = there's no need. Also used as short answers: 不必。／不用了。

examples.id: You don't need to work overtime today.

check.q: The 'no need' answer to 我必須帶書嗎？

latihan.q: 明天是星期天，你（　）來公司。
latihan.why: 不用 + V = no need to.

latihan.q: 我必須帶書嗎？ — （　），老師會給你。
latihan.why: The negative of 必須 is 不用/不必, not 不必須.
不必 + V = need not (a bit more formal than 不用).

latihan.q: 報告已經寫完了，你（　）再寫了。
latihan.why: Already done → no need any more: 不用.

pendukung.meaning: to finish, to be over (吃完, 寫完)

catatan.point: Obligations at work: 必須、不用、不必、要求
note: 必須 = must (obligatory, no choice) — stronger than 要: 明天要開會，我必須寫完報告。
Its negative is 不用 / 不必 = no need (✗ 不必須). 不用 is more colloquial, 不必 a bit more formal; both can be a short answer: 不必。
要求 = requirement (noun): 公司的要求; or a verb: 老闆要求我們每天寫報告。
V + 完 = finish: 寫完報告. V + 得 + 很好 = do something well: 你的報告寫得很好。
為什麼？ = why? Answer with a reason: 明天要開會，我必須寫完報告。

latihan.q: 我今天（　）加班，不能跟你吃飯。
latihan.why: 必須 = must.
V + 得 + 很好 = do well.

latihan.q: 明天要開會，我必須寫（　）報告。 (finish)
latihan.why: V + 完 = finish.

latihan.q: 今天你不（　）加班了，太好了！
latihan.why: 不用 = no need.
為什麼 = why.

modules.title: 要是颱風來了，就不去溫泉了。
modules.title_py: Yào shì tái fēng lái le, jiù bú qù wēn quán le.
modules.title_id: If the typhoon comes, we won't go to the hot spring.
modules.scene: Meimei suggests going to a hot spring in Beitou, but the news forecasts a typhoon. They make a conditional plan.
can_do: Understand weather news: 颱風、中心、方向、度
Talk about locations & estimates: 地點、大概
modules.exam_link: Typhoon news & conditional plans are a typically Taiwanese context in 聽力 Part 4 and 閱讀 Part 5.

lines.zh: 大文，週末我們去溫泉吧！
lines.py: Dà wén, zhōu mò wǒ men qù wēn quán ba!
lines.id: Dawen, let's go to a hot spring this weekend!

lines.zh: 新聞說颱風大概週末會來。
lines.py: Xīn wén shuō tái fēng dà gài zhōu mò huì lái.
lines.id: The news says the typhoon will probably come this weekend.

lines.zh: 要是颱風來了，就不去溫泉了。
lines.py: Yào shì tái fēng lái le, jiù bú qù wēn quán le.
lines.id: If the typhoon comes, we won't go to the hot spring.

lines.zh: 颱風的中心在哪裡？
lines.py: Tái fēng de zhōng xīn zài nǎ lǐ?
lines.id: Where's the centre of the typhoon?

lines.zh: 在臺灣的南方，方向是往北部。
lines.py: Zài Tái wān de nán fāng, fāng xiàng shì wǎng běi bù.
lines.id: It's south of Taiwan, heading towards the north.

lines.zh: 溫泉的地點在哪裡？
lines.py: Wēn quán de dì diǎn zài nǎ lǐ?
lines.id: Where's the hot spring?

lines.zh: 在北投。春季去溫泉最好。現在二十度，不冷也不熱。
lines.py: Zài Běi tóu. Chūn jì qù wēn quán zuì hǎo. Xiàn zài èr shí dù, bù lěng yě bú rè.
lines.id: In Beitou. Spring is the best time to go to a hot spring. It's 20 degrees now — not cold, not hot.

lines.zh: 我們可以去溫泉。下雨的話，我們就不去了。
lines.py: Wǒ men kě yǐ qù wēn quán. Xià yǔ de huà, wǒ men jiù bú qù le.
lines.id: We can go to the hot springs. If it rains, we won't go.

grammar.explain: 要是 = if (more colloquial than 如果, B18). 就 marks the result in the second clause.

examples.zh: 要是颱風來了，就不去溫泉了。
examples.id: If the typhoon comes, we won't go to the hot spring.

options: 要是你有空，我們就去看電影。
你要是有空就，我們去看電影。
就要是你有空，我們去看電影。

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 4, 12
note: 要是 is more colloquial, 如果 a bit more formal; both can close with …的話: 要是明天天氣熱的話，我們就去游泳。
既然…，就… is for something ALREADY certain, not a supposition: 既然你不想去，我們就不去了。
只要…就… = as long as …, then …; 只有…才… = only if …, then …: 只要你有空，我們就去。 / 只有週末，我才有空。

latihan.why: 要是 + condition，(S) + 就 + result.
要是 = if (supposition), paired with 就.

options: 要是你有空，就我們去溫泉。
你有空要是，我們就去溫泉。
要是你有空，我們就去溫泉。
latihan.why: 就 goes AFTER the subject of the second clause.

latihan.q: （　）明天天氣好，我們就去山上。 (a bit more formal than 要是)
latihan.why: 如果 = 要是; 要是 is more colloquial, 如果 a bit more formal.

grammar.explain: 的話 goes at the END of the condition: 下雨的話 = if it rains. It can be combined with 要是/如果: 要是下雨的話.

examples.zh: 下雨的話，我們大概就不去了。
examples.id: If it rains, we might not go.

latihan.why: Condition + 的話 = if ….
的話 goes at the END of the condition.

latihan.q: 要是你不舒服的話，就（　）家休息吧。
latihan.why: …的話，就 + V: "if …, then …".

latihan.q: 颱風來了的話，我們（　）不去溫泉了。
latihan.why: …的話 also pairs with 就.

catatan.point: Plans and weather: 要是 / 的話 / 大概
note: 要是 … (的話)，(S) 就 … = condition → decision. The 就 part can drop the subject: 要是颱風來了，就不去溫泉了。
了 at the end marks a CHANGED plan: 就不去了 = then we won't go after all.
大概 = probably; 會 = will (prediction): 颱風大概週末會來。 新聞說… = the news says ….
Weather/place words: 度 (degrees): 二十度; 不冷也不熱 (just right); 中心 (centre), 方向 (direction), 地點 (location), 南方 (the south); 春季 = spring (more formal than 春天).

latihan.why: 大概 = probably.
度 = degrees (temperature).

latihan.q: 要是颱風來了，就不去溫泉（　）。 (plan changes)
latihan.why: 了 at the end = the plan changes.

latihan.q: 溫泉的（　）在哪裡？ — 在北投。
latihan.why: 地點 = location.
南方 = the south.

Express an effect suffered with 被…V得… (被感冒弄得很累)

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 昨天下午我去打籃球，打了兩個小時，（1），衣服都溼了。晚上我開始（2），一直咳嗽，也（3）。今天早上我去看醫生，醫生說不太（4），多喝水、多休息就好了。我桌上的麵包（5），我只好喝牛奶。

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 上個星期弟弟感冒了，後來我也感冒了。我一直咳嗽、流鼻水，晚上也常常頭痛。醫生給了我一些藥，說一天吃三次。可是第三天我找不到藥了，問了媽媽才知道，是被弟弟吃掉了，他以為那是他的藥。媽媽只好再帶我去看醫生。
tasks.question: 為什麼媽媽又帶他去看醫生？
tasks.why: 藥被弟弟吃掉了 → the medicine was gone. A is not mentioned. C is true, but not why he went back to the doctor. D is not mentioned.

grammar.point: 被 + (N) + V得 + effect — made … by …
grammar.pattern: S + 被 + N + V + 得 + effect
grammar.explain: The passive pattern with 得 stresses the EFFECT on the subject: 我被這個感冒弄得很累 (this flu has worn me out).

examples.zh: 我被這個感冒弄得很累。
examples.id: This flu has really worn me out.

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 33
note: 被 is used when the subject UNDERGOES something, often unpleasant: 我的藥被弟弟吃掉了。 The doer can be left out if unknown: 我的腳踏車被偷了。
One event, three viewpoints: 弟弟吃了我的藥 (plain) · 我的藥被弟弟吃了 (被: focus on the medicine) · 弟弟把我的藥吃了 (把: focus on what the doer did).
As with 把, the verb after 被 cannot stand alone: 被…吃掉了、被…弄得很累.

latihan.why: S (affected) + 被 + doer + V.
Doer + 把 + O + V: focus on what the doer did.
被 + N + V得 + result.
Order: S + 被 + doer + V (+ result/了).

grammar.explain: 掉 after a verb = something is used up/thrown away/lost through that action: 吃掉 (eaten up), 丟掉 (thrown away), 用掉 (used up).

examples.id: My little brother ate all my medicine!

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 31
note: 掉 is one of the result complements (V + result): 吃掉、丟掉、賣掉 = until gone. Other result complements: 吃完、吃飽、洗乾淨、看見、買到.
A result not reached is negated with 沒: 我沒吃完。 Able/unable to reach a result: V得/不 + result: 吃得完 / 吃不完。

latihan.why: V + 掉 = until it is gone.

latihan.q: 蛋糕被弟弟吃（　）了，一點都沒有了。
latihan.why: 吃掉 = eaten up.
A result not reached: 沒 + V + result.
V + 不 + result = unable to reach that result.

pendukung.meaning: to do; to make; to fix
to finish, to be over (吃完, 寫完)

catatan.point: Being ill: symptoms, 一直, 被
note: Symptoms: 發燒 (fever), 咳嗽 (cough), 流鼻水 (runny nose), 頭痛 / 頭很痛 (headache), 流汗 (sweat).
你怎麼了？ = what's wrong? Answer with the symptom + 了 (new state): 我發燒了。
一直 + V = continuously since some time: 從昨天一直咳嗽。
被 for something that happens to you (often unpleasant): 我的藥被弟弟吃掉了！ 我被這個感冒弄得很累。
以為 = thought (wrongly): 他以為是糖果。 為什麼 = why: 他為什麼吃你的藥？

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 27
note: 一直 + V = continuously from some point until now: 我從昨天一直咳嗽。
Compare 一向 = has always been so (habit): 他一向不喜歡吃藥。

latihan.why: 你怎麼了？ = what's wrong?
一直 + V = continuously.

latihan.q: 他（　）是糖果，所以吃了我的藥。 (thought)
latihan.why: 以為 = thought (wrongly).
頭很痛 = my head hurts a lot.
流汗 = sweat.

tasks.text: 週末的百貨公司很熱鬧，因為有很多東西打折。我跟媽媽去逛街，一樓的衣服打八折，二樓打七折，三樓打五折，一層比一層便宜。我們在三樓等了半個小時才買到。可是回家以後，我發現那件外套大了一點。
tasks.question: 他們為什麼去三樓買？
tasks.why: 三樓打五折 — the cheapest (一層比一層便宜). A: they actually waited half an hour. B is not mentioned. D is not given as the reason.

grammar.point: 一 M 比一 M — more and more …
grammar.pattern: 一 + M + 比 + 一 + M + Vs
grammar.explain: Comparing one after another so that it feels like it's increasing: 一件比一件便宜 (each one cheaper than the last), 一天比一天冷 (colder day by day).

examples.zh: 這裡的衣服一件比一件便宜！
examples.id: The clothes here get cheaper and cheaper!

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 34
note: Close in meaning to 越來越 + Vs (more and more …): 天氣越來越熱了。 Pattern 越 V 越 Vs: 雨越下越大。

latihan.why: 一 + M + 比 + 一 + M + Vs = more and more ….

latihan.q: 這家店的東西一件比一件（　）。
latihan.why: After 一 M 比一 M comes the adjective directly, without 很.
越來越 + Vs = more and more ….
Order: 一天比一天 + Vs.

grammar.explain: Vs了一點 = a little more than you'd like (a mild complaint): 貴了一點 (a bit too expensive), 大了一點 (a bit too big). Compare 有點貴 (B20) and 貴一點 (B21, asking for a more … one).

examples.id: It's discounted, but still a bit too expensive.

check.q: 'The shoes are a bit too small' =

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・基礎篇》 Unit 23–24
note: Vs了一點 = a bit more than wanted, similar to 有一點 + Vs: 這雙鞋大了一點 ≈ 這雙鞋有一點大。 Then ask for the right one: 我要小一點的。
Compare with 比 + difference: 這雙比那雙大一點。

latihan.q: 這雙鞋大（　）一點，我要小一點的。
latihan.why: Vs + 了一點 = a bit more than wanted.
Order: Vs + 了 + 一點.
Vs了一點 ≈ 有一點 + Vs.

latihan.q: 這雙比那雙大（　）。 (a little bigger)
latihan.why: A 比 B + Vs + 一點.

catatan.point: Shopping at a sale: 打折、排隊、逛街
note: 打八折 = pay 80% (20% off); 打七折 = pay 70%. The number is the part you PAY, not the discount!
Calculating: 一千塊打八折 = 八百塊; 一千塊打七折 = 七百塊.
逛街 = go shopping/window-shopping; 排隊 = queue; 熱鬧 = lively (positive). 好 + Vs = so (exclamation): 人好多、好熱鬧！
還是 + Vs = still: 打八折，還是貴了一點。 再 + V + 一下 = … a bit more: 我們再逛一下吧。

latihan.q: 這件外套本來一千塊，現在打七折，是（　）。
latihan.why: 打七折 = pay 70%: 700.
排隊 = queue.
還是 + Vs = still.

latihan.q: 我們（　）逛一下吧。 (a bit more)
latihan.why: 再 + V + 一下 = … a bit more.

Express feelings: 開心、沒想到、心情、感覺、輕鬆、不得了
modules.exam_link: Feelings & surprises appear in 聽力 Part 4 ('how does the speaker feel?'). 沒想到 marks something unexpected.

tasks.why: 沒想到 = I never expected. 不但 needs 而且; 而且 does not start a sentence like this.

tasks.instr: Choose the right phrase for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 今天是我的生日，（1）朋友們給我辦了一個派對。他們（2）準備了蛋糕，（3）還送了我一個禮物。我的（4）好得不得了。派對以後，我覺得很（5）。
tasks.why: (1) unexpectedly. (2)(3) 不但…而且… (4) mood. (5) relaxed. 「擔心」 contradicts the happy mood.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 上個週末我去朋友家。我以為只是一起吃飯，沒想到一開門，大家都說：「生日快樂！」我才知道他們給我辦了一個生日派對。他們不但準備了蛋糕，而且還唱歌給我聽。那天我的心情好得不得了，覺得很輕鬆，也很開心。
tasks.question: 這個人去朋友家以前，以為要做什麼？
tasks.why: 我以為只是一起吃飯. A is what actually happened (沒想到). B and D are part of the party.

grammar.point: 不但…而且… — not only …, but even …
grammar.pattern: S + 不但 + A，而且 + (還) + B
grammar.explain: A stronger form than 不但…還…: 而且 introduces a second, more surprising point. 還 can be added after 而且.

examples.zh: 你不但來了，而且還帶了禮物！
examples.id: You didn't just come — you brought a present too!

check.q: 'This cake is not only cheap, but tasty too' =
options: 這個蛋糕不但便宜，而且好吃。
這個蛋糕而且便宜，不但好吃。
不但這個蛋糕便宜好吃而且。

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 9
note: Same subject: 不但 after the subject (臺灣的小吃不但多，而且好吃). Different subjects: 不但 before the first subject (不但我喜歡，而且我朋友也喜歡).
The topic can come first, then two parts with their own subjects: 這家店，不但東西便宜，而且老闆很好。
既…又… is like 不但…而且… for two qualities, but more formal: 既便宜又好吃。

latihan.q: 這家店不但便宜，（　）東西很好吃。
latihan.why: 不但 … 而且 …: not only …, but also ….

options: 他會說中文不但，而且會說英文。
他不但會說中文，而且會說英文。
不但他會說中文，而且會說英文。
latihan.why: Same subject → 不但 goes AFTER the subject.

options: 我不但去了，而且他也去了。
我去了不但，他而且也去了。
不但我去了，而且他也去了。
latihan.why: Different subjects → 不但 goes BEFORE the first subject.
沒想到 = unexpectedly / I didn't expect.

grammar.explain: 而且 adds information in the same direction (both positive or both negative): 很輕鬆，而且很高興. It can be used without 不但.

check.q: Choose the right word: 這家店很便宜，＿＿東西很好。

latihan.why: 而且 = moreover, adds something in the same direction.

options: 而且這件衣服很漂亮不貴。
這件衣服很漂亮，而且不貴。
這件衣服很漂亮，而且很貴不。
latihan.why: 而且 starts the second part.
不只 … 而且 … ≈ 不但 … 而且 ….
Two positive points → 而且; 可是 is for contrast.

pendukung.meaning: to finish, to be over (吃完, 寫完)

note: 沒想到 = unexpectedly (a surprise, usually pleasant): 沒想到你不但來了，而且還帶了禮物！
不但 … 而且還 …: 還 adds the stress "even also".
Vs + 得不得了 = extremely …: 我的心情好得不得了！
心情 = mood: 心情很好 / 不好. 感覺 = to feel/feeling: 你感覺怎麼樣？ — 很輕鬆。
開心 = happy (colloquial); 看到你開心，我也很開心。 哇 = wow (exclamation).

catatan.rujukan: 《看圖學中文語法・進階篇》 Unit 15
note: 以為…，沒想到… = thought …, but unexpectedly …: 我以為你不來，沒想到你不但來了，而且還帶了禮物！

latihan.why: Vs + 得不得了 = extremely ….
感覺 = to feel: 你感覺怎麼樣？
哇 = wow.

latihan.q: 這個蛋糕不但好看，（　）好吃。
latihan.why: 不但 … 而且 ….
也 = also.
